components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height:49px; border:0; border-radius:5px; padding:0 24px; background:#8c7ab8; color:#fff; font:500 18px 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; transition:transform 140ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); background:#655784; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #d4c3f0; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform:scale(.97); }

narrative.overview: Eurydion feels like opening an illustrated travel journal at sunset. A single painterly environment carries the emotion, while the interface recedes into calm typography, thin rules, and honest media. The system is spacious and nostalgic without becoming ornamental costume.
keyCharacteristics: Warm parchment content fields against a cool dusk image
Elegant serif display type paired with a quiet interface sans
Sparse lavender controls and hairline ornament
Real media and statistics, with designed empty and error states

rules.name: The Rare Lavender Rule
rules.body: Lavender marks action and orientation. It never washes an entire reading surface.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Serif carries story and identity; sans carries operation and data. Do not introduce a third typographic voice.

rules.name: The Continuous Journey Rule
rules.body: Sections change density and temperature, but never detach into floating page-level cards.

rules.name: The Image-First Depth Rule
rules.body: The illustration and thumbnails provide depth. Interface chrome does not imitate physical materials.

dos: Do let one decisive illustration carry the page's fantasy atmosphere.
Do keep real Roblox and YouTube media as the focus of content sections.
Do preserve the dusk-to-parchment-to-night rhythm across future surfaces.
Do use short, interruptible interaction transitions and honor reduced motion.
donts: Don't add neon borders, animated gradients, or dashboard chrome.
Don't use giant rounded pills or one radius for every object.
Don't add labels above headings merely to decorate the hierarchy.
Don't invent statistics, testimonials, or media to fill an API failure.
Don't cover cards with vines, flowers, grain, or fantasy decoration.
